summary.zh: React Native 样式、导航与动画实践
summary.en: React Native styling, navigation, and Reanimated motion.

description.zh: 整理 React Native 的样式方案、导航结构与 Reanimated 动画写法，兼顾跨平台表现和流畅度。适合搭建移动应用骨架，或优化现有页面的导航与转场。
description.en: Covers React Native styling, navigation structure, and Reanimated animations while keeping cross-platform behavior smooth. Fits new mobile app skeletons or improving navigation and transitions in existing screens.
